overallNotes: Caleb Martin Hebert (born 1984-11-02) is a 40+ year-old floodplain outreach specialist for Harris County Flood Control District in Humble, Texas. This is the most developed persona in the dataset with 30 slices spanning nearly 4 years (Jan 2025 - Nov 2028). The arc shows a remarkable professional evolution from workshop presenter to corridor follow-through specialist to the county's go-to adoption model builder. Major themes: (1) flood mitigation outreach work evolving from broad awareness to concentrated case-level follow-through; (2) recurrent storm-season anxiety and stress-triggered acid reflux as a persistent health challenge; (3) caregiving for his mother Dorothy (diabetes, mobility, doctor resistance) as a long-running family stressor; (4) his marriage to Lena as a stabilizing force that requires active maintenance; (5) friendships with Miguel Trevino (engineer colleague) and Terrence Guidry (GIS friend) as key support structures; (6) home repair financial strain as a recurring theme that deepens his empathy for residents; (7) small leisure discoveries (audiobooks, plant photography, Astros scorekeeping, legal procedurals) as markers of emotional recovery. The current tags are all broad categories (work, family, health, etc.) that are technically present in every slice but useless for search. The existing decisions fields are generally accurate but could be more specific. Open_loops fields are absent across all slices. Focus fields often repeat the first line of the conversation rather than summarizing what the conversation is actually about. All emotional_tone fields are set to 'neutral' but many conversations have clear emotional valence.
